body:
(Using DXC version 2023-03-01)

I run into an issue where adding header dependency dumping to file options (a.k.a. `-MD -MF file.d`) has prevented the error log to be outputted in the console. Expected behaviour is having the errors outputted to the command line since the dependencies are dumped to a file instead of the console.
Because of this, I currently have to run the dxc command twice (once with the dep dumping and once without) to get the proper command line output, which is not the best.
title: Dumping header dependencies to file prevents error output
